name: app-store-provider
title: AppStoreProvider
description: Optional Solid app-shell state provider for generated UI source that coordinates TanStack Store-backed command, shortcut, shell, and workspace state.

meta.api: Exports createAppStore, AppStoreProvider, useAppStore, useRequiredAppStore, and useAppStoreSelector. createAppStore returns a TanStack Store plus Solid-native actions for command menu visibility/query/selection, command group registration, shortcut preferences/scope, shell theme/sidebar state, and app-owned workspace values.
meta.accessibility: AppStoreProvider has no widget role and does not replace Core primitive keyboard, focus, or ARIA behavior. It renders a neutral div with stable ui-app-store provider data attributes so generated app shells can style or inspect the provider without adding semantics.
meta.controlledUncontrolled: Use initialState for local uncontrolled provider state, pass an externally created TanStack Store for app-owned state, or pass a createAppStore result when callers need shared actions outside the component tree.
meta.ssrHydration: The provider does not read document, window, layout, or storage during creation/render. Persisting state to storage and registering global hotkeys should be layered in app-owned source after hydration.
meta.dataAttributes: The root provider emits data-scope="ui-app-store", data-part="provider", and data-slot="app-store-provider".
meta.limitations: This source coordinates app-shell state only. It does not register keyboard shortcuts, persist preferences, implement command search/ranking, own route permissions, or provide Core primitive behavior.

parity.visualReference: No visual reference is required because AppStoreProvider is a neutral app-shell state provider, not a styled visible widget.
parity.baseUi: Intentionally differs from Base UI because Base UI owns primitive interaction state; this provider only shares app-level state across generated UI source.
parity.kobalte: Intentionally differs from Kobalte primitive context shape by exposing app-shell store actions instead of widget-scoped primitive APIs.
parity.tanstackStore: Uses TanStack Store as the provider state engine and exposes Solid selectors through useSelector so generated UI can subscribe to narrow state slices.
parity.tanstackHotkeys: Stores shortcut preferences and active shortcut scope for app-level hotkey integrations, but leaves actual registration to KeyboardShortcuts or user-owned source because TanStack Hotkeys remains preview/alpha.
